verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a webhooks capability is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event-subscription mechanism. The only adjacent items are in-app messaging, a timeline view and downloadable reports, and none of these is a webhook.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
